audit_items.proof_trace: All financial price consumers call through staleness-checking wrappers: non-liquidation borrowing paths use `get_price_with_check` (EMA + spot staleness + divergence bound); liquidation eligibility uses `get_price` (EMA staleness); liquidation seize-amount calculation uses `get_spot_price` (spot staleness) after EMA eligibility is already asserted upstream in the same call chain. No code path accesses a raw `x_oracle.price()` result without at least one `check_price` staleness guard on the component used for the decision.
